_meta.teaches: How a facilitator opens a workshop, enrolls a single attendee, and immediately publishes the empty leaderboard. Demonstrates the W4-PR2 lab mode end-to-end: workshop creation → enrollment → leaderboard fanout — all under the same algotrade pack so the attendee can drop into recipe_to_paper next with their freshly-minted sandbox_id.

name: Workshop lab kickoff
description: Facilitator one-liner. Creates a workshop, enrolls a single attendee (parameterised by env var so a script can fan it across a roster), and renders the leaderboard. After this playbook, the attendee runs recipe_to_paper with `WORKSHOP_SANDBOX_ID` set to the value the lab returns.
